$description: Copied from _template.json. Every step of the brand ramp points at the same step of the yellow ramp, where the client's own yellow sits closest to 200; each step says what it paints. The button keeps the corners it has with no brand.

50.$description: Light: the fill behind tags and soft highlights (color.fill.brand-subtle). Dark: nothing; tags use 800 there.

100.$description: Paints nothing yet, in light or in dark. Set it anyway, so the ramp is whole when a semantic needs this step.

200.$description: Paints nothing yet, in light or in dark. Set it anyway, so the ramp is whole when a semantic needs this step.

300.$description: Light: nothing. Dark: text on a subtle brand fill, such as a tag's (color.text.brand).

400.$description: Light: nothing. Dark: links (color.text.link) and the keyboard focus ring (color.border.focus).

500.$description: Paints nothing yet, in light or in dark. Set it anyway, so the ramp is whole when a semantic needs this step.

600.$description: Light: the main button (color.fill.brand) and the keyboard focus ring (color.border.focus). Dark: the main button (color.fill.brand).

700.$description: Light: the main button under the pointer (color.fill.brand-hover), text on a subtle brand fill (color.text.brand) and links (color.text.link). Dark: the main button under the pointer (color.fill.brand-hover).

800.$description: Light: nothing. Dark: the fill behind tags and soft highlights (color.fill.brand-subtle).

900.$description: Paints nothing yet, in light or in dark. Set it anyway, so the ramp is whole when a semantic needs this step.

radius.$description: The button's corners, the same in light and in dark, since a mode changes colours only. With no brand they follow radius.control; point at radius.pill for pill-shaped buttons.
